author: "Jil Wendt"
format: html
editor: visual
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

Claustrum and target ROI volumes in preterm- (VP/VLBW) and full-term-born adults (BLS cohort; Supplementary control and robustness analyses, section 2). Mean ± SD and range per group; groups compared with two-sample t-tests, uncorrected.

- Input: `data/adults_harmonized_control_volumes.csv` (claustrum volume in structural space, seed volume and voxels and target volumes in diffusion space, demographics)
- Outputs (`outputs/tables`):
  - `Revision_volumes_seed_FTvsPT_<date>.csv`: claustrum volumes (results/volumes_seed_BLS.csv)
  - `Revision_volumes_target_FTvsPT_<date>.csv`: target volumes (results/volumes_target_BLS.csv)

# 1 Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

tab_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")
```

#### Lookup tables for variable names

```{r}
roi_labels <- c(
  cp_ac_occ_l_ipsi  = "Occipital Associative (L)",
  cp_ac_occ_r_ipsi  = "Occipital Associative (R)",
  cp_ac_par_l_ipsi  = "Parietal Associative (L)",
  cp_ac_par_r_ipsi  = "Parietal Associative (R)",
  cp_ac_pfc_l_ipsi  = "Prefrontal Associative (L)",
  cp_ac_pfc_r_ipsi  = "Prefrontal Associative (R)",
  cp_ac_temp_l_ipsi = "Temporal Associative (L)",
  cp_ac_temp_r_ipsi = "Temporal Associative (R)",
  cp_c_pos_l_ipsi   = "Posterior Cingulate (L)",
  cp_c_pos_r_ipsi   = "Posterior Cingulate (R)",
  cp_c_ant_l_ipsi   = "Anterior Cingulate (L)",
  cp_c_ant_r_ipsi   = "Anterior Cingulate (R)",
  cp_pc_aud_l_ipsi  = "Primary Auditory (L)",
  cp_pc_aud_r_ipsi  = "Primary Auditory (R)",
  cp_pc_mot_l_ipsi  = "Primary Motor (L)",
  cp_pc_mot_r_ipsi  = "Primary Motor (R)",
  cp_pc_sens_l_ipsi = "Primary Somatosensory (L)",
  cp_pc_sens_r_ipsi = "Primary Somatosensory (R)",
  cp_pc_vis_l_ipsi  = "Primary Visual (L)",
  cp_pc_vis_r_ipsi  = "Primary Visual (R)",
  cp_sc_hip_l_ipsi  = "Hippocampus (L)",

```

### Load data

```{r}
dat <- read_delim(
  here::here("data", "adults_harmonized_control_volumes.csv"),
  delim = ";",
  trim_ws = TRUE,
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  na = c(""," ","NA", "NaN", "n/a", ".", "-9999","999"),
  col_types = cols(
    Subject = col_character(),
    ID      = col_character()
  ),
  guess_max = 10000
) |> janitor::clean_names()

# --- recode and name important factors ---
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(case_when(
      groupcode == 0 ~ "FT",
      groupcode == 1 ~ "PT",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("FT", "PT")),

    sex = factor(case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ "Male",
      sex == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
  )
```

# 2 Table summary of seed and target volumes

```{r}
summ_vol_one <- function(var, label, digits = 0){
  d <- dat |>
    dplyr::select(group, dplyr::all_of(var)) |>
    tidyr::drop_na()
  
  x <- d[[var]][d$group == "FT"]
  y <- d[[var]][d$group == "PT"]
  
  use_welch <- var.test(x, y)$p.value < 0.05
  tt <- t.test(x, y, var.equal = !use_welch)
  
  ms <- function(z) {
    paste0(
      formatC(mean(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      " ± ",
      formatC(sd(z), format = "f", digits = digits)
    )
  }
  
  rng <- function(z) {
    paste0(
      "[",
      formatC(min(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      "–",
      formatC(max(z), format = "f", digits = digits),
      "]"
    )
  }
  
  df_txt <- if (use_welch) {
    sprintf("%.1f", unname(tt$parameter))
  } else {
    sprintf("%d", as.integer(round(unname(tt$parameter))))
  }
  
  tibble(
    Variable = label,
    n_FT = length(x),
    FT = ms(x),
    range_FT = rng(x),
    n_PT = length(y),
    PT = ms(y),
    range_PT = rng(y),
    mean_diff = mean(x) - mean(y),   # positive = larger in FT
    t_df = sprintf(
      "%.2f(%s)%s",
      unname(tt$statistic),
      df_txt,
      if (use_welch) "*" else ""
    ),
    p = tt$p.value
  )
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  ifelse(p < .001, "<.001", sprintf("%.3f", p))
}

# Claustrum seed voxels/volumes
seed_spec <- tibble::tribble(
  ~var,           ~label,                                             ~digits,
  "struct_vol_l", "Claustrum volume, structural space, L (mm³)",       0,
  "struct_vol_r", "Claustrum volume, structural space, R (mm³)",       0,
  "seed_vol_l",   "Claustrum seed volume, diffusion space, L (mm³)",   0,
  "seed_vol_r",   "Claustrum seed volume, diffusion space, R (mm³)",   0,
  "seed_vox_l",   "Claustrum seed voxels, diffusion space, L",         0,
  "seed_vox_r",   "Claustrum seed voxels, diffusion space, R",         0
)

stopifnot(all(sapply(dat[seed_spec$var], is.numeric)))

res_seed <- purrr::pmap_dfr(seed_spec, summ_vol_one)

# Target volumes
target_vars <- grep("^target_vol_", names(dat), value = TRUE)

stopifnot(
  length(target_vars) == 22,
  all(sapply(dat[target_vars], is.numeric))
)

target_spec <- tibble(var = target_vars) |>
  mutate(
    label = dplyr::recode(
      sub("^target_vol_", "cp_", var),
      !!!roi_labels,
      .default = var
    ),
    digits = 0
  ) |>
  arrange(match(
    sub("^target_vol_", "cp_", var),
    names(roi_labels)
  ))

res_target <- purrr::pmap_dfr(target_spec, summ_vol_one)

# Format as tables
tab_seed <- res_seed |>
  transmute(
    Variable,
    `FT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(FT, range_FT),
    `PT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(PT, range_PT),
    `Mean difference (FT − PT)` = round(mean_diff, 0),
    `t(df)` = t_df,
    P = fmt_p(p)
  )

tab_target <- res_target |>
  transmute(
    Variable,
    `FT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(FT, range_FT),
    `PT mean ± SD [range]` = paste(PT, range_PT),
    `Mean difference (FT − PT)` = round(mean_diff, 0),
    `t(df)` = t_df,
    P = fmt_p(p)
  )

# save outputs
readr::write_excel_csv2(
  tab_seed,
  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_volumes_seed_FTvsPT_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
)

readr::write_excel_csv2(
  tab_target,
  file.path(tab_dir, paste0("Revision_volumes_target_FTvsPT_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"))
)
```
